sara_devex: FYI - onboarding script failed for a couple of trials. Root cause looks like SDK/REST parity plus retry heuristics around model alias creation.

ali_sdk: Quick details?

mike_onboarding: Repro: curl POST /models/m-9/aliases -> 202 (async). Node SDK helper createAlias -> 404 then SDK retries on 4xx and finally errors. Sample app expects alias to exist after helper returns.

ben_infra: SDK retry middleware should not retry on client 4xx for non-idempotent endpoints. Might be misclassified.

ali_sdk: Our classifier currently treats trailing resource POSTs as idempotent. That's wrong. Workarounds: call REST directly or change retry config. Both are bad for DX.

sara_devex: Agreed. Proposed actions:
- ali_sdk: add POST /models/:id/aliases to SDK surface and fix classifier (PR + unit test).
- mike_onboarding: change sample app to poll on 202 or call REST until SDK fix ships. Add integration test.
- ben_infra: check if header normalization (X-Request-ID casing) affects routing; file infra ticket if so.

ali_sdk: Will open PR tonight and include integration test for 202->poll.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for branch sdk/alias-fix to staging at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z.

ben_infra: filed infra-1102 for header-case regex.

sara_devex: Thanks — tag me on PRs and I'll bump priority.
